rules: Root questions are written without DocAtlas-specific names, internal field names, file names, or status constants.
Lookup queries are paraphrases/facet restatements derivable from the root question only.
Lookup queries must not contain expected-answer-only vocabulary, guessed source names, or project identifiers.
